scenario: At narrow width, decorative fleet totals remain above the active incident while the desktop layout correctly prioritizes active execution.

review.summary: The mobile hierarchy reverses the desktop's task priority.
alternative_constraints: Preserve active incident priority at narrow widths.
Do not retain the desktop KPI ordering as a stacked column.

findings.title: Mobile puts totals before the active incident
findings.observation: The 390px capture shows fleet totals before the incident action.
findings.product_mismatch: An on-call operator needs the active incident first on a phone.

evidence.fact: Four fleet totals precede the active incident card.
